clips.title: The story
paras: Thrall is the Warchief of the Horde and the ruler of Durotar, holding court from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. Once a human slave raised to be an arena gladiator, he broke the chains of his people, rediscovered their ancient shamanic traditions, and led them across the Great Sea to build a new homeland.

Born Go'el, the son of Frostwolf chieftain Durotan and Draka, Thrall was orphaned as an infant when his parents were murdered by Gul'dan's assassins. He was discovered by human commander Aedelas Blackmoore, who named him 'Thrall'—meaning slave—and raised him at Durnholde Keep as an arena fighter with an education in human tactics. Aided by his foster sister Taretha Foxton, Thrall eventually escaped his captors. Guided by the Frostwolf exile Drek'Thar, he cast aside demonic corruption to master the elemental spirits, becoming the first of a new generation of orcish shaman.

Thrall joined forces with the legendary Orgrim Doomhammer to liberate the lethargic orcs languishing in Alliance internment camps after the Second War. When Doomhammer fell in battle, he bestowed his black plate armor and mighty warhammer upon Thrall, naming him the new Warchief. Following prophetic visions from the mysterious Prophet Medivh, Thrall led his people to commandeer human ships and sail across the Great Sea to the forgotten continent of Kalimdor, escaping the doom falling upon the Eastern Kingdoms.

In Kalimdor, Thrall reshaped the Horde from a warmongering engine into an alliance of survival and honor. He rescued the Darkspear trolls led by Vol'jin and allied with Cairne Bloodhoof's tauren before leading the coalition alongside human and night elf forces to defeat the Burning Legion atop Mount Hyjal. Afterward, Thrall founded the nation of Durotar and its capital Orgrimmar, named after his father and mentor. Despite maintaining an uneasy peace with Jaina Proudmoore's Theramore, Thrall now balances the defense of his fragile nation with controversial alliances, such as admitting the Forsaken of Lordaeron into the Horde fold.
